documentation.file_docstring:
Tests for process-level agent isolation.

Verifies that agents run in separate OS processes and can be
forcefully terminated using real OS signals (SIGKILL).
inline_comments: Give the OS time to deliver the signal.
signal() returns False because the handler raises (caught by _deliver)
But state WAS updated before the raise
Should NOT raise -- real kill instead of exception.
member_docstrings: simple_agent: Agent that returns a value immediately.
slow_agent: Agent that takes a while to complete.
crashing_agent: Agent that raises an exception.
infinite_agent: Agent that never returns (for kill testing).

catching_agent: Adversarial agent that catches BaseException.
In-process: this catches AgentKern
heartbeat_agent: Agent that does work in small steps.
returning_agent: Agent that returns a numeric value.

functions.name: test_sigkill_with_no_process_cooperative_fallback
functions.doc:
SIGKILL with no isolated process falls back to cooperative mode.

The cooperative ``_handle_kill`` sets terminated/stopped state and
raises ``AgentKernelPanic``, which is caught by ``_deliver()``.
We verify the state transition occurred correctly.
